subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Varka and the others

705550101.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}! All wrapped up for the day?

705550102.text: Paimon hears you did a great job holding down the fort while she was out delivering drinks with Glenfidia!

705550105.text: ...Whatever the reason, the Honorary Knight is clearly one of the most talented mixologists in Mondstadt.

705550106.text: #Considering how short a time {M#he's}{F#she's} been doing this, I believe that someday, {M#he}{F#she} has the potential to give the legendary bartender at The Cat's Tail a run for her money.

705550107.text: I fully support your decision, Grand Master. The Honorary Knight has really put in the hard yards.

705550108.text: The drinks stand will remain open for a little while longer to provide a proper welcome to our returning expedition members. Then, once we locate suitable premises, we also plan to look at operating a permanent service...

705550109.text: Hooray! Everyone in the Knights of Favonius will get to drink all the delicious cocktails they like!

705550110.text: Nothing short of what I'd expect from a true disciple of Hertha. You've really considered this thoroughly, Glenfidia!

705550111.text: Also, if I may, Honorary Knight, regarding the special cocktails you've developed... Would you mind leaving the recipes with us? We'd like to add them to the official menu.
